description:
At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

title: Medior AI Architect
description:
Je hebt al een paar jaar ervaring binnen IT, data of architectuur en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen op het gebied van Artificial Intelligence. Je vindt het interessant om complexe technische vraagstukken te doorgronden, maar krijgt ook energie van het vertalen van technologie naar concrete oplossingen voor een organisatie. Daarnaast weet je complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan verschillende stakeholders. Herkenbaar? Dan is deze rol als Medior AI Architect binnen het traineeship Business & IT een mooie volgende stap in jouw carrière.

Wat ga je doen als Medior AI Architect?

Als Medior AI Architect werk je aan de ontwikkeling en toepassing van AI binnen een grote IT-organisatie. Je helpt mee om AI op een veilige, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige manier toe te passen en zorgt dat nieuwe AI-oplossingen goed aansluiten op de bestaande IT- en dataomgeving.

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van AI, data, architectuur en strategie. Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende teams en stakeholders en vertaal je organisatiedoelen naar technische mogelijkheden. Je krijgt te maken met onderwerpen als generative AI, machine learning, data governance, security en integratie.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Het ontwikkelen en verder uitwerken van een visie op AI binnen de organisatie

  • Het ontwerpen en beheren van AI-architecturen, referentiearchitecturen en roadmaps

  • Het vertalen van businessdoelen naar AI-capabilities, technische ontwerpen en architectuurkaders

  • Het adviseren over de toepassing van generative AI, machine learning en data-oplossingen

  • Het beoordelen van solution designs en toetsen of deze aansluiten op de gewenste architectuur

  • Het adviseren over security, privacy, ethiek en verantwoord gebruik van AI

  • Het meedenken over MLOps, modelbeheer, datakwaliteit en lifecycle management

  • Het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en bijdragen aan AI-governance

  • Het verbinden van AI met bestaande data-, bedrijfs- en IT-architecturen

  • Het begeleiden en adviseren van productteams, management en andere stakeholders

  • Het volgen van ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI, LLM's, MLOps en nieuwe AI-technologie

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel specialist te zijn. We zoeken iemand die al een stevige basis heeft binnen architectuur, data en/of AI en zich verder wil ontwikkelen richting een brede AI-architectuurrol. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw kennis verder te verdiepen en tegelijkertijd ervaring op te doen met strategische en organisatorische vraagstukken.


Wat kun je verwachten van het traineeship?

Binnen het traineeship ontwikkel je jezelf verder tot een veelzijdige IT-professional. Je combineert werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling en brengt wat je leert direct in de praktijk.

Je volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die aansluiten bij jouw ontwikkelrichting. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding van een people manager waarmee je werkt aan je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Omdat je al relevante werkervaring hebt, ligt de nadruk binnen dit traject op verdere verdieping en specialisatie. Samen kijken we welke richting binnen AI, data en architectuur het beste aansluit bij jouw ambities.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen de €3500 en €3800, passend bij jouw ervaring en kennis

  • Direct een vast contract

  • Jaarlijkse evaluatie met een salarisverhoging tot €500

  • 25 vakantiedagen & vakantiegeld

  • Reiskostenvergoeding op maat

  • Talloze trainingen en erkende certificaten waarmee je verder bouwt aan je cv

  • Eén-op-één begeleiding van een persoonlijke people manager gedurende het hele traject

  • Een professionele omgeving waarin je jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen binnen AI, data en architectuur

  • Altijd gezelligheid op de werkvloer met leuke borrels, toffe teamuitjes en evenementen

Dit vragen wij van jou

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Informatica, Data Science, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring binnen architectuur, IT, data en/of AI

  • Ervaring of aantoonbare affiniteit met AI- en ML-technologieën, bijvoorbeeld LLM's, deep learning, MLOps, vector databases of data pipelines

  • Je hebt interesse in de strategische én technische kant van AI

  • Je kunt complexe technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen aan verschillende doelgroepen

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt goed schakelen tussen techniek, business en management

  • Je bent analytisch, proactief en organisatiesensitief

  • Je vindt het interessant om mee te denken over security, privacy, governance en verantwoord gebruik van AI

  • Ervaring met cloudplatforms zoals Azure is een pré

  • Kennis van privacy-by-design, AI governance, de AI Act en GDPR is een pré

  • Je bent bereid om minimaal 2 dagen per week in Zwolle, Den Haag of Assen te werken

De werkzaamheden vinden plaats vanuit Zwolle, Den Haag of Assen, afhankelijk van de opdracht en het team waarin je wordt geplaatst.

Deze vacature is onderdeel van onze werving voor de traineeshipklas die in maart 2027 start. We komen graag nu al met je in contact.

description:
Overview

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

â¢ Tasks are reviewed by the client before approval

title: Software Engineer, Connected Vehicle Platform
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Berlin team is looking for a Software Engineer - Connected Vehicle Platform, to design, build, and operate software connecting vehicle systems with infotainment, cloud, and mobile ecosystems. You will bridge low-level communication paths and high-level vehicle interfaces, developing reusable platform capabilities while supporting brand-specific configurations.

This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain communication services, client libraries, gateway and routing components, and deployment configurations; implement message publication and subscription, request/reply interactions, service discovery, signal routing, gateway translation, and reliable failure handling.

  • Contribute to software components written in C++, Rust, Go, Kotlin, or other languages used across vehicle and cloud platform layers; evolve interface contracts, schemas, configuration models, and generated APIs while preserving compatibility for existing consumers.

  • Decide whether functionality belongs in a reusable platform abstraction, gateway mapping, vehicle service, application, or vehicle- or brand-specific integration; deploy and validate services across vehicle-oriented compute platforms, virtualized embedded environments, simulators, software-in-the-loop systems, benches, and prototype vehicles.

  • Investigate issues across vehicle interfaces, gateways, message-passing services, vehicle-model APIs, and consuming applications using logs, traces, packet captures, diagnostics, and test tools; improve reliability, performance, observability, security, deployment automation, and test coverage.

  • Support partner developers through integration guidance, examples, troubleshooting, documentation, and technical issue triage; collaborate with hardware, firmware, embedded, cloud, infotainment, security, validation, product, and external partner teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) plus 3+ years developing software in distributed systems, embedded platforms, or middleware; strong C++, Rust, Go, or Kotlin skills across a multi-language platform.

  • Experience with messaging, gRPC, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and designing or using Protobuf contracts (or equivalent), APIs, and schemas.

  • Familiarity with CAN/DBC, vehicle gateways, signal integration, and connected devices; physical-input or HMI gateway experience is a plus.

  • Ability to deploy and debug on embedded/virtual platforms (Android Automotive, Linux, test benches, simulators) with experience in CI/CD, Docker, or Bazel.

  • Knowledge of mutual TLS, auth, telemetry (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and end-to-end troubleshooting using logs, traces, and packet captures.

  • Strong communication skills to support developer adoption via SDKs and docs; experience with platform abstractions, automotive partners, Clean Architecture, and TDD/DDD.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of applying for or being considered for employment.

Please see our Candidate Data Privacy Notice (English) and Candidate Data Privacy Notice (Serbian) for more information.

title: DevOps Engineer (GCP)
description:
As a DevOps Engineer (GCP) at Particle41, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our software development and IT operations processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both software development and IT operations, with a focus on automating and streamlining processes to achieve efficient and reliable software delivery for our customers. You will work closely with development and operations teams of our customers to build, deploy, and maintain critical systems, ensuring the reliability and scalability of the customers' infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with software developers, system administrators, and other stakeholders to understand the requirements and objectives of projects.
  • Collaborate on the design, implementation, and maintenance of continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and configurations.

Automation and Tooling:

  • Design, implement, and manage automation processes for software build, deployment, and configuration.
  • Evaluate, select, and implement tools and technologies to enhance the efficiency of the development and deployment processes.

Infrastructure Management:

  • Manage and maintain GCP infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Deployment Manager, and others.
  • Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the software delivery process, including build, test, and deployment phases.

Monitoring and Performance:

  • Develop and implement monitoring solutions using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging to ensure the health and performance of systems and applications.
  • Proactively identify and address issues related to system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Security and Compliance:
  • Implement and maintain security best practices in infrastructure and application deployment including IAM, Security Command Center, and VPC Service Controls.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company security policies.

Troubleshooting and Support:

  • Provide support for development and operations teams, addressing issues related to build failures, deployment problems, and system outages.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to respond to and resolve critical incidents.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience with GCP services including Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Operations Suite.
  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Ruby.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
  • In-depth knowledge of containerization technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. Hands-on experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
  • Solid understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) concepts and tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Certified (Current or Expired) in at least one of the following: GCP Cloud Engineer Associate, GCP Cloud Architect Professional, GCP Cloud Developer Professional, GCP Cloud DevOps Engineer Professional, GCP Cloud Security Engineer Professional, GCP Cloud Network Engineer Professional

title: Security Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for a Security Engineer to build and automate the technical controls behind our security program. Most of our infrastructure is bare metal in colocation datacenters — GPU-intensive, running containerized workloads on Docker, managed with Ansible, and shipped through CI/CD on GitHub Actions — with AWS used for overflow capacity and a small set of services. Our engineering culture is high-trust and fast-moving. That means controls have to be delivered as code, be reproducible, and produce their own audit evidence — anything that depends on someone remembering to do it manually will not survive.

You will own real surface area: host hardening and configuration management across the fleet, vulnerability and patch management, penetration testing, container security, detection and response, CI/CD and supply chain security, and the engineering work behind our SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 obligations. You will also be expected to use AI and agentic tooling aggressively to punch above your weight on a small team, and to help us secure the AI systems we build and the AI tools we adopt internally.

This is the hands-on technical seat. A GRC and Security Compliance Lead owns policy authorship, security questionnaires, and the auditor relationship; you own the controls themselves and the evidence they generate, and you give that role the technical answers it needs.

This role reports to the Director of Information Security.

Note: as reflected on our published compensation ranges, we are open on level. Strong mid-level and senior candidates are both in scope, and we will calibrate title, scope, and compensation to demonstrated experience.

About Deepgram

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent infrastructure — used by enterprises and developers to build production voice applications at scale. Our models are trained and served on our own infrastructure, and we offer hosted, dedicated single-tenant, and self-hosted deployment options so customers can meet their own data residency and retention requirements. Learn more at deepgram.com.

Responsibilities

  • Build, deploy, and maintain security controls across our bare-metal fleet and AWS footprint — access management, network segmentation and firewalling, encryption and secrets management, logging and detection coverage, endpoint security, and vulnerability management.

  • Own configuration management and host hardening as code with Ansible, so baselines are reproducible across hundreds of Linux hosts and drift is detectable rather than merely documented.

  • Secure containerized workloads: Docker image build pipelines, registry scanning, runtime hardening and detection, and secrets management.

  • Run vulnerability management end to end — discovery, prioritization by real exploitability rather than raw CVSS, driving remediation with engineering teams, and reporting on it.

  • Own patch and update management as a program: the server fleet, the endpoint fleet, base images, OS and package updates, firmware where it matters, and dependency upgrades. Set and hold patch SLAs, track exceptions, and automate the routine cases so they do not depend on anyone remembering.

  • Own the penetration testing lifecycle: scoping and vendor selection, scheduling, triaging findings into engineering work with real owners and dates, verifying fixes on retest, and producing the summary we can share with customers.

  • Write detections, tune out noise, and take part in incident response. Improve log, telemetry, and security-agent coverage where we are blind.

  • Run periodic log and access reviews as a standing control, and automate the collection so each cycle produces its own evidence rather than a scramble.

  • Automate compliance evidence collection for SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001, and support audit fieldwork on technical questions — the GRC lead owns the auditor relationship and the narrative; you own the systems that make the evidence true and repeatable.

  • Harden GitHub Actions CI/CD and the software supply chain: dependency and secret scanning, action pinning, SBOM, artifact and image signing, least-privilege OIDC in place of long-lived credentials.

  • Apply AI and agentic tooling to security work — triage, evidence gathering, code review, detection engineering — and help secure how the rest of the company uses AI.

  • Provide the technical input behind customer-facing security work: questionnaire and architecture answers, penetration test summaries, and hardening guidance for customers running Deepgram self-hosted.

Skills Needed

  • Solid experience in security engineering or infrastructure engineering with a security focus — enough that you have owned controls in production, not just recommended them.

  • Deep Linux. You should be comfortable hardening, debugging, and reasoning about a large fleet of physical Linux hosts — users and sudo, SSH, systemd, kernel and package updates, host firewalls, and what a host-based agent is actually doing.

  • Ansible at fleet scale is required. You automate first and document second.

  • Strong scripting. Python and/or Go, plus real shell competence.

  • Production experience securing Docker containers and the pipelines that build them.

  • Hands-on experience securing GitHub and GitHub Actions: branch protection, CODEOWNERS, workflow permissions, secrets, and third-party action risk.

  • Experience running vulnerability and patch management as an ongoing program — including the unglamorous part, which is getting other teams to actually ship the fix.

  • Experience managing third-party penetration tests from the inside: scoping them well, and turning a report into closed engineering work rather than a PDF in a folder.

  • Hands-on involvement in at least one formal audit — ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 — as the engineer producing and defending evidence, not only as a reader of the report.

  • Comfortable using AI coding and agentic tools in daily work, and clear-eyed about their risks: prompt injection, secret leakage, and supply chain exposure.

  • Pragmatic. Controls that block shipping without a proportionate risk reduction get routed around, and we would rather you name the trade-off than pretend it does not exist.

Nice to Have

  • Datacenter or colocation experience: network segmentation, out-of-band management (IPMI/BMC), physical and vendor controls.

  • Detection engineering or SIEM/HIDS ownership at scale (for example Wazuh, OSSEC, Elastic).

  • Secrets management with HashiCorp Vault.

  • AWS security (IAM, SCPs, VPC) and Terraform.

  • Kubernetes security.

  • Offensive security background: penetration testing or red teaming.

  • PCI DSS work inside a cardholder data environment.

  • Ownership of a secure SDLC program.

  • Experience with GPU infrastructure, ML platforms, or multi-tenant inference workloads.

  • Certifications such as OSCP, GIAC, CISSP, or AWS Security Specialty.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we're ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.

Overview:

Springboard is launching an online course for aspiring Sterile Processing Technicians who have no prior experience in healthcare. Springboard is looking to hire an engaging Live Instructor with prior experience teaching aspiring Sterile Processing Technicians (CSPTs) preparing for the CRCST exam, and who is able to serve as a founding instructional partner and subject matter expert, helping to shape session structure, pacing, and exam-readiness strategy for a first-time program launch.

Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate 60-minute, large-group “review sessions” (20-30 students per session) aligned to key curriculum & CRCST focus areas over a 14-week period.
    • Each lecture will be held 2x weekly to accommodate time zones.
  • Lead engaging, motivational sessions that help build student confidence in material.
  • Prepare independently for live sessions (up to 3 additional hours per week).
  • As this is a new program, work with Springboard’s learning team to develop and modify all session agendas and lecture decks. [Note: We’re looking for someone who likes to build out session agendas and content, not just teach it. No branding/design skill required.]
  • Develop gamified approaches using tools like Kahoot and others.
  • Offer 2 live session slots per week, to accommodate different time zones.
  • Perform tool demonstrations as needed.
  • Support CRCST exam prep by holding exam review sessions towards the end of the course.
  • Respond to student questions about course material over email as needed.
  • Other needs as they arise.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least five years’ experience working as a sterile processor. Experience working in a hospital-based sterile processing department preferred.
  • Current CRCST certification through HSPA (certification must be active).
  • Prior teaching, training, or precepting experience in Sterile Processing is required. Experience teaching in online or hybrid environments is required.
  • Ability to break down complex sterilization and infection prevention concepts for students with no prior healthcare experience.

Other Requirements:

  • Must have excellent computer skills and must have reliable internet (no hot spots). Instructors must be logged onto their computers and utilize their computers for all sessions.
  • Ability to work independently, think critically, and reliably commit to a lecture schedule.
  • Must be able to support 24-hour response times to Springboard emails, and 24-48 business-hour response times to student questions.
  • Strong student empathy, excellent communication skills, and a positive outlook on the Sterile Processing role & career.
  • You live and work in the US.

Pay: Up to $40 an hour, pending location and experience

What you'll do 

  • Build agentic systems with our clients and embed them in their core processes, from first prototype to production. 

  • Ship concrete artifacts: agents, MCP servers, agent skills and integrations used in real workflows. 

  • Turn what works into reusable patterns, for accilium and, where we can, for the open-source community. 

  • Work on-site with client teams, explain what you built, and spot the next use case. 

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI development stacks. 

  • Expand accilium’s build capabilities for agentic systems and deploy solutions for our internal value chains 

 

What you bring 

  • A Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, engineering or similar. 

  • Hands-on coding in Python and/or TypeScript; you're comfortable with APIs, git and the command line. 

  • Things you've built and can show us: a GitHub profile, a side project, a thesis, a hackathon entry. Shipped is better than polished. 

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs: you've built with an agent framework, written a prompt or eval pipeline, or connected a model to real data. 

  • You enjoy explaining technical work to non-technical people and learning how their work actually runs. 

  • Process-design instinct and hands-on experience with analytical, generative and agentic AI stack (agent harnesses, context engineering, skills) 

  • Deep understanding of how model behavior affects enterprise outcomes 

  • You like figuring things out, can operate autonomously and thrive under ambiguity as well as under pressure 

  • Ambition to move fast and take risks 

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, problem-solving and interpersonal skills 

  • Willingness to work on-site with clients in DACH 1–3 days per week. 

  • German and English at C1 level*  

*Global scale - Table 1 (CEFR 3.3): Common Reference levels (coe.int)

How you'll grow

  • Structured onboarding with our FDE team and pairing with engineers at &amp.

  • A clear path from FDE to Senior FDE, with regular feedback and a named mentor.

  • Real ownership early: your first build reaches a client or internal team within your first weeks.

What we offer

  • Salary: €61,000 gross per year for graduates; €82,000 with 2 years of relevant full-time experience all-in contract.

  • Funded frontier-model API access with no token budget gating for experimentation.

  • Latest tech kit (Mac or Windows/ WSL), flat hierarchies and an open-door culture.

  • Up to 1 home-office day per week; client on-site days are part of the job.

  • Public transport ticket, corporate benefits, team events (reTreat, acc'sPerience, acc'smas Party).

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. 

 

This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence.


Some of the benefits we offer:

* Remote Work Environment

* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days

* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits

* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution

* Life and Disability

* Employee Assistance Program

* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning

* Super HAPI Fun Club


Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work.  We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

 

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

  • Act as a strategic advisor: Understand enterprise procurement challenges and position Zip as a transformational solution for efficiency and cost control.

  • Solution-sell with vision: Demonstrate Zip’s immediate impact while aligning with customers’ long-term digital transformation goals.

  • Shape the future: As an early sales leader in a hyper-growth startup, help refine Zip’s sales strategy, process, and team culture.

  • Leverage best-in-class sales tools: Utilize Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach to optimize outreach and pipeline management.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

  • Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

  • Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

  • Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

 

Perks and Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health Insurance

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement werk je aan uiteenlopende datavraagstukken binnen een organisatie in de publieke sector. Je helpt data toegankelijk, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar te maken en draagt zo bij aan betere informatievoorziening en bedrijfsprocessen.

Wat ga je doen als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement?

Als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement ondersteun je een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en de ontwikkeling van data- en informatieproducten. Je houdt je voornamelijk bezig met geografische data, maar werkt ook met Business Intelligence (BI) en gestructureerde datasets. Je analyseert gegevens, bewaakt de kwaliteit en denkt mee over hoe data slimmer kan worden ingezet. Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende collega's en adviseer je over oplossingen die aansluiten bij de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel een expert te zijn. Het is vooral belangrijk dat je een brede interesse in datamanagement hebt, analytisch kunt denken en het leuk vindt om verschillende soorten datavraagstukken op te pakken. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis in de praktijk in te zetten en verder te ontwikkelen.

Via The Trainee Company combineer je werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Binnen het traineeship Data & Analytics ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte Data-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken. Denk hierbij aan PowerBI, Python, SQL en Azure.

In het eerste jaar van het traineeship leg je een sterke basis in data, systemen, processen en communicatie. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding van jouw people manager en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen tijdens je opdracht. Zo leer je niet alleen in de praktijk, maar werk je ook gericht aan je technische én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

·       Ervaring met datamanagement, bij voorkeur binnen een overheidsorganisatie, is een pré.

Je denkt actief mee over AI-toepassingen en helpt de organisatie betere beslissingen te nemen op basis van betrouwbare data. Dit doe je vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Den Bosch en vanuit huis.

Jouw baan als business intelligence ontwikkelaar:

Als business intelligence ontwikkelaar werk je op het snijvlak van data, techniek en business. Je beheert en ontwikkelt ons datawarehouse en maakt een vertaling van de informatiestrategie van HeinenoordZicht Groep naar praktische BI-oplossingen. Verder denk je graag gevraagd en ongevraagd mee over mogelijkheden op het gebied van data en hoe je deze het beste voor onze organisatie kunt gebruiken.

Je staat in nauw contact met de business om hun behoeften op te halen als het gaat om informatievoorziening. Je begrijpt als geen ander hoe onze bedrijfsprocessen werken en hoe je deze kunt omzetten naar slimme technische oplossingen en bruikbare stuurinformatie. Met jouw expertise en analytisch inzicht, krijgt de business de juiste informatie aangeleverd om hun klanten uitstekend te bedienen. Bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van rapportages en dashboards.

De functie van business intelligence ontwikkelaar combineert architectuur, ontwikkeling, beheer en advisering. Je werkt samen met gebruikers, projectleiders, management en externe specialisten. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat BI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch goed werken, maar ook aansluiten bij de behoeften van de organisatie.

Wat krijg je van ons:

  • Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 3.838,- tot € 7.623,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring.

  • Een dienstverband van 32 of 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.

  • Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank.

  • Maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-.

  • 27 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG.

  • De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden.

  • De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken, waarbij ook gezorgd wordt voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek.

  • Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt, onderdeel van de stabiele, internationale NN Group.

  • Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid.

Jouw profiel:

Je krijgt energie van het vertalen van complexe informatievraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen. Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken en kunt technische mogelijkheden begrijpelijk uitleggen aan gebruikers en management. Je kijkt kritisch naar processen en systemen, signaleert verbetermogelijkheden en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van informatievoorziening. Daarbij weet je het evenwicht te bewaren tussen techniek, gebruikerswensen en organisatiedoelen.

Verder vragen wij:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en ervaring in een soortgelijke functie als business intelligence ontwikkelaar.

  • Ervaring met SQL, Python, Azure en Databricks.

  • Wanneer je naast bovenstaande ook verstand hebt van Power BI en/of ANVA maakt dit jou misschien wel de ideale kandidaat.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, in woord en geschrift.

Dit zijn wij:

Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs. Samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler.


Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes over financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, onze passie, de rijke ervaring, maar ook de lokale verbinding. Dat is de reden waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen. En wat ons verbindt. HeinenoordZicht Groep is een gaaf bedrijf: goed geregeld, aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, aantrekkelijk voor klanten en financieel gezond.

De afdeling:

Jouw werkplek vind je in ons splinternieuw en moderne hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, dicht bij het Provinciehuis. Maar thuiswerken is ook helemaal onderdeel van onze cultuur. Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor data en informatievoorziening binnen HeinenoordZicht Groep. Je rapporteert aan de manager data- en informatiemanagement.

De sfeer is informeel. Werken in jeans en op sneakers vinden we de normaalste zaak van de wereld. We geven je ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen vanuit je eigen expertise en werken vanuit vertrouwen en samenwerking.

title: Public Sector Account Executive - Civilian
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard is looking for a Federal Health Account Executive to help expand our presence within large organizations. In this role, you’ll own the full sales cycle with federal customers—from building pipeline through closing complex deals.

Successful candidates are disciplined in their sales process, strong at developing pipeline, and comfortable navigating complex federal buying environments. You’ll work closely with sales leadership, sales engineering, marketing, and customer success to help organizations adopt Chainguard’s solutions and improve how they build and secure software.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
  • Build and manage pipeline within a defined set of federal accounts
  • Lead discovery, qualification, and deal strategy using frameworks such as MEDDPICC
  • Communicate Chainguard’s value to technical stakeholders, security leaders, and executive buyers
  • Partner with Sales Engineering, Public Sector Partner Team, and Customer Engineering to support evaluations and technical validation
  • Manage complex Federal sales cycles including procurement, security reviews, and negotiations
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting
  • Consistently meet or exceed revenue and pipeline targets

What We're Looking For

  • 8-10+ YOE selling complex technical products into federal organizations
  • 5+ years of closing experience in the SaaS/Security/DevOps industry required
  • 5+ years’ experience covering Federal Healthcare, HHS, VA and DHA
  • A track record of building pipeline and consistently closing revenue
  • Comfortable running disciplined sales processes (MEDDPICC or similar)
  • Ability to identify customer pain and sell based on measurable business value
  • Experience navigating multi-stakeholder buying cycles from technical teams to executives
  • Strong deal management and forecast discipline across complex opportunities
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable operating in fast-growing environments with evolving processes

Desired Qualifications:

  • Domain experience with one or more of the following strongly recommended: Compute platforms (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), DevOps Tooling, CICD platforms (Github, Gitlab, jenkins), and overall SDLC.
  • Startup experience
  • A strong sales aptitude and fundamental understanding of the sales process
  • A sound, tech-savvy business acumen and the ability to articulate a compelling value proposition in a complex and evolving business environment
  • Ability to thrive in an agile environment with an ever-evolving set of solution

$350K OTE (50/50)

Bonus Points:

  • Startup experience
  • Domain experience with one or more of the following: Compute platforms (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), DevOps Tooling, CICD platforms (Github, Gitlab, Jenkins) and overall SDLC.

Compensation: $350,000 OTE (50/50)

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
