title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - North Central
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:
You will assess a prospect’s technical requirements and apply extensive knowledge of Chainguard products to illustrate how a deal will satisfy the client’s unmet needs. You will cultivate relationships with decision-makers at all levels of an organization and negotiate the competing needs of multiple stakeholders within an organization. You will secure technical wins using methods such as demos, RFP/RFI responses, lead POVs, partner with engineering for requested features, and participate in conferences and industry events (when applicable).

What you'll do:

  • Partner with our Sales Team to help customers evaluate and prove the value of our solution
  • Focus on acquiring new customer “logos” in addition to growing existing customer base
  • Own all technical aspects of sales opportunities and assisting current customers understand the value of Chainguard
  • Day to day responsibilities include:
    • Listen to our customers and understand their challenges
    • Conduct product demonstrations and POVs/POCs
    • Actively participate in webinars, meetups, conferences and other marketing initiatives

What we're looking for:

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer / Pre-Sales Engineer
  • Experience with MEDDPICC and or Command of the Message sales frameworks
  • Experience selling into Enterprise (3+ years) and Mid Market prospects
  • Experience in the following areas:
    • Container technologies (Kubernetes, Serverless, Docker)
    • Cloud technology (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.)
    • Cloud security or containers security
    • App Security
  • Startup experience
  • Smart and passionate people that can persevere to success.
  • People acting as trusted advisors, able to build credibility with customers.
  • Strong team players committed to help and mentor their peers.

*Must be located in the North Central region of the US*

OTE RANGE (based on experience/location): $200,000 - $235,000

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

©2026 Chainguard. All Rights Reserved.

title: Sr. Counsel, Commercial
description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Counsel, Commercial to play a key role on our Legal team, supporting our global go-to-market organization and advising on the commercial relationships that drive our business. You’ll own complex, high-value negotiations with enterprise customers, partners, and vendors, bringing practical legal guidance and sound business judgment to agreements involving SaaS, professional services, data privacy, and procurement. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders, you’ll help teams navigate competing priorities, resolve challenging contract issues, and make informed decisions that balance growth with legal and business risk. Beyond individual transactions, you’ll help shape how commercial legal support scales at Amplitude by strengthening templates, improving contracting workflows, and equipping teams with the training and tools to move forward confidently.

As a Sr. Counsel, Commercial, you will:

  • Lead commercial negotiations: Draft, review, and negotiate strategic customer and partner agreements, including SaaS agreements, professional services agreements, data processing agreements, and nondisclosure agreements, and support responses to RFPs.

  • Support vendor relationships: Structure and negotiate inbound vendor agreements, partnering with internal stakeholders to address business needs and manage legal risk.

  • Advise our go-to-market teams: Provide practical guidance on commercial terms, contracting issues, and risk mitigation, balancing legal considerations with business priorities.

  • Make contracting more efficient: Partner with Sales and Finance leadership to improve self-service resources, commercial negotiation workflows, and contract lifecycle management. Maintain and update templates as our products, business, and applicable laws evolve.

  • Build knowledge across the business: Develop training and resources on contracting processes, key negotiation issues, data privacy, and relevant compliance requirements so teams can make informed decisions and move deals forward.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You bring experience supporting a B2B SaaS company and understand the needs of a global go-to-market organization.

  • You take a practical, solutions-oriented approach and help teams find a path forward through complex negotiations.

  • You work effectively through ambiguity, take initiative, and adapt as priorities change.

  • You build strong relationships, welcome different perspectives, and collaborate well while independently owning your work.

  • You’re interested in using AI tools thoughtfully to streamline legal workflows and improve efficiency.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You have a JD and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

  • You bring 5-12 years of experience negotiating commercial agreements through a combination of in-house and law firm roles.

  • You have strong drafting and negotiation skills, with experience independently managing complex commercial transactions.

  • You demonstrate sound business judgment and can assess legal risk in the context of commercial goals.

  • You communicate clearly and translate complex legal issues into practical guidance for people without a legal background.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: UI Developer
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer.

 

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

description:

Position Type: Per Diem
Work Arrangement: Field-Based â Patient Home Visits
Compensation: $110â$130 per visit

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

title: Fleet Operations Trainer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

Our Fleet Operations Team ensures that our vehicles and staff continuously meet the highest standards in safety, performance, and regulatory compliance. Working collaboratively across various functions, the team plays a key role in developing and delivering training, maintaining operating standards, and supporting the professional growth of our people within a fast-paced and innovative environment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, making recommendations for improvements.

  • Maintain up-to-date training records and ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

  • Conduct regular assessments of operating standards across teams and individuals to uphold our quality objectives.

  • Develop and maintain training materials, including manuals, presentations, and online resources.

  • Work closely with subject matter experts to identify areas for improvement in training content, delivery, and operating standards.

  • Monitor and analyse training metrics to identify trends and suggest opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and oversee implementation of quality assurance processes for both training programs and operating standards.

  • Support staff professional development and course completion, in conjunction with Team Leads.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand and anticipate training needs related to the growth of commercial operations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Building, evaluating, and improving training programs for fleet operations.

  • Upholding and enhancing the effectiveness and compliance of all operating standards across teams.

  • Creating and updating a library of high-quality training materials.

  • Implementing and tracking quality assurance processes for all training and operational exercises.

  • Supporting the development and progression of Wayve’s staff through tailored training and development initiatives.

  • Analysing data to ensure continuous improvement of both training content and delivery methods.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You hold a full clean DE driving licence and have at least 8 years' driving experience (mainly in DE).

  • You have no blameworthy insurance claims within the past three years.

  • You remain calm and controlled in pressured situations.

  • You’re receptive to feedback, eager to learn from mistakes, and have a growth mindset.

  • You enjoy working closely with people in a team environment.

  • You can manage your wellbeing (including fatigue/stress) and have proven personal strategies for doing so.

  • You have proven experience as a team coordinator or in a similar role.

  • You demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills—both one-to-one, within your team, and when engaging other stakeholders.

  • You can work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • You have excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, time management, and organisational ability.

  • You are proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office suite.

  • You have excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 

Desirable:

  • Recognised Assessor qualification.

  • Qualified Vehicle Safety Operator with a current qualification.

  • Recognised Quality Assurance qualification.

 

Additional Requirements:

  • Available to work full-time onsite (Leonberg office), 5 days a week.

  • Must disclose any second job as part of the application process.

  • All applicants will be subject to a health check before/after employment.

  • Employment is contingent upon passing training, pre-employment checks, and ongoing drug/alcohol testing in line with company policy. Testing will occur during your onsite interview.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Engineer at Artificial, you'll be the technical backbone of our sales process across Germany and the wider DACH/EU specialty (re)insurance market. You'll partner closely with Account Executives from first technical conversation through to signed contract, translating the messy realities of underwriting, policy administration, and claims workflows into clear, compelling demonstrations of what our API-first platform can do.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Lead technical discovery calls with prospective carriers, MGAs, and brokers to understand their existing systems, data, and workflow pain points

  • Design and deliver tailored product demos and proofs of concept that showcase the specific benefits of Artificial’s product suite. to

  • Act as the bridge between prospects and Product - feeding real-world requirements back into the roadmap, as well as Forward-Deployed Engineering to support delivery.

  • Support a smooth handoff to the delivery team once a deal closes, so technical context isn't lost

  • Represent Artificial at industry events, webinars, and broker/carrier roundtables across the region

  • Work closely with both, the market facing team in the DACH area and the sales engineering team we are building across the globe

About you

  • Experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or solutions / consulting role, ideally within insurtech, fintech, or B2B SaaS sold to enterprise buyers

  • Comfortable working hands-on with a broad range of software development tooling (e.g. GitHub, REPL) — you can speak credibly to a developer and a Head of Underwriting in the same day

  • Experienced with AI coding tools, their benefits and how to use the safely

  • Exposure to specialty or commercial (re)insurance workflows (underwriting, policy admin, claims) is a strong plus, though not a hard requirement

  • Fluent in both German and English, given the focus on the DACH market - and our ambition to scale across continental Europe

  • Preferably based in Germany, comfortable working remotely with occasional travel to customers, partners, and conferences

  • A natural communicator who enjoys translating technical detail into business value — and vice versa

  • Energized by the pace and ambiguity of a London-based Series B startup, with a bias toward getting hands dirty rather than waiting for perfect process

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.


    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.


    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
description:
ABOUT NAXON

Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones.

Why now: rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site.

Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM).

THE ROLE

You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there.

As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor

  • Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS

  • Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones

  • Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation

  • Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback

  • Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos

  • Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning

  • Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents

  • Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware

  • MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience

WHY JOIN NAXON

  • The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop

  • Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it

  • Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI

  • Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member

  • Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who have built, scaled and exited companies

  • A supportive and inclusive team that values ownership and creativity

title: Data Ingenieur (m/w/d)
description:
Data Ingenieur


Du bist technisch versiert, probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus und möchtest nicht bei jeder Entscheidung durch bestehende Strukturen ausgebremst werden? Als Data Ingenieur erwartet dich eine Umgebung, in der vieles neu aufgebaut wird und du deine technischen Vorstellungen aktiv einbringen kannst. Von der Architektur über Datenpipelines bis hin zu Data Quality und AI Schnittstellen kannst du moderne Lösungen entwickeln und dabei Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung übernehmen. Bewirb dich jetzt und nutze den technischen Spielraum, den diese Position bietet. 

Deine Benefits als Data Ingenieur

  • Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlichem variablem Anteil, das deiner Erfahrung und technischen Expertise entspricht.  

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue eine zentrale Datenplattform von Grund auf mit auf und bringe deine eigenen technischen Ideen ein. Hier gibt es viel Raum, moderne Lösungen auszuprobieren und die technische Architektur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

  • Flexibilität: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst und arbeite flexibel aus dem Homeoffice oder von deinem Wohnort in Deutschland. Für wichtige Meetings, Workshops und den persönlichen Austausch wird gleichzeitig deine Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme vor Ort erwartet. 

  • Workation: Nutze bis zu vier Wochen Workation innerhalb der EU und nach Absprache gegebenenfalls darüber hinaus. 

  • Altersvorsorge: Profitiere von einer betrieblichen Altersversorgung mit 50 % Arbeitgeberbeteiligung. 

  • Entwicklung: Nutze individuelle Weiterbildungen, Sprachkurse und persönliche Lernangebote. 

  • Internationalität: Arbeite in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Deutsch und Englisch als Geschäftssprachen. 

Deine Aufgaben als Data Ingenieur

  • Data Layer: Übernimm Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Databricks basierten Datenplattform inklusive Workspaces, Jobs und Berechtigungen. 

  • Datenpipelines: Entwickle robuste ETL und ELT Pipelines für Banking, Treasury, Payments, Exportfinanzierung und weitere Datenquellen. 

  • Architektur: Gestalte Data Lake und Lakehouse Strukturen sowie skalierbare und performante Datenmodelle. 

  • Data Quality: Implementiere automatisierte Qualitätsprüfungen und stelle Vollständigkeit, Aktualität und Konsistenz der Daten sicher. 

  • Monitoring: Baue Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines, Jobs, Latenzen und Fehler auf. 

  • Governance: Dokumentiere Datenflüsse und Lineage und unterstütze bei Datenklassifizierung, Zugriffskontrollen und regulatorischen Anforderungen. 

  • AI Enablement: Stelle geeignete Daten und Schnittstellen für AI Use Cases und MLOps bereit. 

  • Zusammenarbeit: Unterstütze Fachbereiche bei Datenanalysen und arbeite eng mit Architecture, Platform, Risk und Compliance zusammen. 

Dein Profil als Data Ingenieur

  • Ausbildung: Ein Studium der Informatik, Data Engineering, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage. 

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data Engineering und im Aufbau produktiver Datenplattforment. 

  • Technologie: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Databricks, SQL und modernen ETL und ELT Patterns. 

  • Architektur: Erfahrung mit Data Lake oder Lakehouse Architekturen, Datenmodellierung und Data Quality. 

  • Cloud: Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code in Cloud Umgebungen ist wichtig, idealerweise ergänzt durch Azure- oder AWS-Kenntnisse. 

  • Betrieb: Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Fehlerbehandlung und der Operationalisierung produktiver Datenpipelines. 

  • Kommunikation: Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau. 

  • Pluspunkte: Erfahrungen mit Banking, Finance, Power BI, DORA, SFTP oder AI und ML Datenpipelines. 

Du hast eigene Vorstellungen davon, wie eine moderne Datenplattform aufgebaut sein sollte und möchtest diese auch umsetzen können? Dann wartet hier der technische Gestaltungsspielraum auf dich, den du bei vielen etablierten Strukturen vergeblich suchst.

title: Founders Associate (m/w/d)
description:
Intro

Bei Arvana bauen wir die erste AI-native Go-to-Market-Firma in DACH. Seit 2024 sind wir auf über 5 Mio. € ARR und mehr als 30 Leute im Team gewachsen, und wir legen gerade erst richtig los. Über 200 Unternehmen wie Swisscom, monday.com, Enpal, Talkdesk und FreeNow setzen bereits auf uns.

Als Founders Associate übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für strategische Projekte, baust Prozesse mit Tools wie n8n und Claude auf und treibst sie eigenständig voran. Starten kannst du ab sofort.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für die Finanzplanung, von der Budgetierung bis zum Forecast, und entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse für nachhaltiges Wachstum.
  • Du findest Optimierungspotenziale und automatisierst operative Abläufe mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code und OpenClaw und Plattformen wie n8n, Make.com und Zapier.
  • Du baust moderne Business-Intelligence-Strukturen auf, zum Beispiel mit Snowflake und Looker Studio, und schaffst so datengetriebene Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Du bist Sparring für unsere Gründer bei strategischen und operativen Entscheidungen und bringst eigene Perspektiven in den Wachstumsprozess ein.
  • Du entwickelst neue Business-Ideen und Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie von 0 auf 1 um.
  • Du schaffst Klarheit in komplexen Themen durch saubere Analysen, strukturierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und klare Umsetzungspläne.

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.
  • Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen und 1 bis 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in schnellen Umfeldern wie Startups, Consulting oder VC gesammelt.
  • Führung: Du hast erste Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeitende oder Praktikanten zu führen, und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.
  • Unternehmergeist: Du interessierst dich für den Aufbau von Unternehmen und willst ständig Neues lernen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du bist zielstrebig, proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung.
  • Anspruch: Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an dich und andere und motivierst dein Umfeld mit einer Can-do-Mentalität.
  • Englisch: Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch.

Benefits

  • Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.
  • Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.
  • 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote.
  • Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook.
  • Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket.
  • Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.
  • Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.

Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln?

Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

1. Kurzes Kennenlernen
Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 20-minütigen Call lernen wir uns kennen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob wir zusammenpassen.

2. Personal Fit
Im zweiten Gespräch (ca. 30–45 Minuten) lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen.

3. Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team
Vorab bekommst du eine Case Study aus unserem Alltag, die du zu Hause vorbereitest und dann bei uns im Office in der Rosenstraße 17 vorstellst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

title: SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d) bis zu 80%-Remote
description:
Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen und Teil einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden. Moderne, hochautomatisierte Fertigungsprozesse, eine hohe Variantenvielfalt und eine leistungsfähige Logistik prägen das industrielle Umfeld. SAP bildet dabei die zentralen Geschäftsprozesse über nahezu alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg ab.

Zur Verstärkung des internen SAP-Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d), der eigene Lösungen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und die anstehende Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA aktiv mitgestaltet.

Aufgaben

  • Sie entwickeln und optimieren SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysieren Sie Anforderungen und übersetzen diese in technische Konzepte und praxistaugliche Lösungen.

  • Sie begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Tests und Dokumentation.

  • Sie wirken an der Umstellung auf SAP S/4HANA und der Modernisierung der bestehenden Systemlandschaft mit.

  • Sie unterstützen produktionsnahe SAP-Prozesse, insbesondere im Umfeld von SAP PP und der Maschinenanbindung.

  • Sie entwickeln Schnittstellen zwischen SAP, Produktion, Lager sowie angrenzenden EWM- und MES-Systemen weiter.

  • Je nach Aufgabenstellung setzen Sie moderne Technologien wie SAP Fiori, SAP UI5 und die SAP Business Technology Platform ein.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit den internen IT-Kollegen, den Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern zusammen.

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.

  • Sie haben mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten.

  • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Sie bringen Erfahrung mit SAP PP sowie der Maschinenanbindung im Zusammenspiel mit EWM und MES mit.

  • Sie verstehen SAP-Prozesse und können fachliche Anforderungen analysieren und technisch umsetzen.

  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig und verantwortungsbewusst und schätzen einen hohen Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und verfügen über gute Englischkenntnisse.

Damit ergänzen Sie Ihr Profil idealerweise:

  • Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA, beispielsweise aus Entwicklungs- oder Transformationsprojekten.

  • Kenntnisse in SAP Fiori und SAP UI5.

  • Kenntnisse der SAP Business Technology Platform sowie Erfahrung mit Schnittstellentechnologien wie OData, IDoc oder BAPI.

Benefits

  • Attraktiver Gehaltsrahmen: Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation etwa 70.000 bis 90.000 Euro brutto jährlich auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Gleitzeit sowie die Möglichkeit, in Vollzeit mit 40 Wochenstunden oder in einem individuell abgestimmten Teilzeitmodell zu arbeiten.

  • Homeoffice: Nach der Einarbeitung sind bis zu 80% Homeoffice möglich. Auch gebündelte Präsenzphasen (1 Woche vor Ort, 3 Wochen Homeoffice) sind umsetzbar.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Fachlicher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliche Entwicklungsaufgaben und die Möglichkeit, die SAP-S/4HANA-Transformation unmittelbar mitzuprägen.

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Fachliche Qualifizierungen und SAP-Schulungen nach Bedarf und Abstimmung.

  • Unterstützungsoption bei einem Umzug

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Massageangebote, Corporate Benefits, ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket und vergünstigte Lademöglichkeiten für Elektrofahrzeuge. Nach der Probezeit stehen außerdem Dienstrad-Leasing und eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung zur Verfügung.

title: Sustainability Consultant – PCF/LCA / Climate Tech (w/m/d)
description:
If you do not speak German at a minimum C1 level, please do not apply!

Applying anyway is disrespectful and a waste of both your time and mine.

This requirement is clearly stated for a reason.

No fluent German, no chance. No exceptions!

Unser Kunde

Das Unternehmen ist ein Climate‑Tech‑Start‑up im Bereich Nachhaltigkeits‑Software und Consulting. Mit 11‑50 Mitarbeitenden, Hauptsitz in Berlin und einem remote‑first Team, bietet es eine KI‑gestützte Plattform für CO₂‑Footprinting, PCF‑ und LCA‑Berechnungen sowie CSRD‑Compliance. Es positioniert sich als schneller, produkt‑orientierter Anbieter, der Unternehmen bei der Reduktion ihrer Emissionen unterstützt.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hohe Gestaltungsmacht – du baust den gesamten Beratungsprozess auf und bestimmst die Skalierung.

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe – du trägst direkt zum Klimaschutz bei, indem du Unternehmen beim CO₂‑Footprinting unterstützt.

  • Remote Flexibilität – 100 % Homeoffice aus Deutschland, keine Mikromanagement‑Kultur.

  • Karriere‑Boost – schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einer wachsenden Unit.

  • Attraktives Gehalt – €50‑70 k Jahresgehalt plus Benefits.

  • Innovatives Tech‑Stack – Arbeit mit einer KI‑basierten Sustainability‑Plattform.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des PCF/LCA‑Kundenprozesses.

  • End‑to‑End‑Betreuung von Kundenprojekten: Datenaufnahme, Modellierung, Validierung und Ergebnispräsentation.

  • Entwicklung von Regelwerken und Methodologien für PCF/LCA‑Kunden.

  • Mitgestaltung der Software: Input für Produktfeatures und Automatisierungsideen.

title: People Business Partner
description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

As a People Business Partner, you will work closely with our Europe Engineering, Product & Design, and G&A teams, partnering with leaders and managers to support org health, talent strategy, and people programs that move the business forward. This role sits at an exciting intersection — you'll be deeply embedded with your European counterparts while also partnering closely with our US-based teams to help bridge and strengthen our global company.

  • Partner closely with leaders and managers across Europe Engineering, Product & Design, and G&A teams to support a full range of people situations (performance, org health, change management, etc)

  • Build strong relationships across your client groups — earning trust quickly and developing a deep understanding of the business context in Europe across multiple regions (Ukraine, Germany, Poland)

  • Serve as a key bridge between Europe and US counterparts, bringing a global lens to how we design and deliver people programs, and helping ensure our practices work well across geographies

  • Support talent processes, including performance management, talent reviews, and calibrations — partnering with managers to maintain a high and consistent bar

  • Collaborate with the broader People team (L&D, Compensation, Ops, Recruiting) to help run and deliver programs and projects that serve your client groups

  • Partner with leaders, finance, and recruiting on headcount planning and team structure conversations, translating business needs into the right people investments

 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of people partner or HR business partner experience, ideally with exposure to global or multi-region companies

  • Experience supporting Engineering, Product, Design, and/or G&A orgs is preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to build high-trust relationships with managers and leaders, and to show up as a credible, strategic partner

  • Strong judgment in navigating employee situations with speed, structure, and genuine care

  • Understanding of the cultural and employment landscape across key European markets

  • Comfortable working across time zones and geographies — you understand what it takes to bridge a global company and bring people together

  • Experience partnering with other People teams and business partners like Finance and Recruiting

  • Ready to roll up your sleeves and figure out and build the right solutions with cross-functional partners, not just execute established processes

  • Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can operate proactively with independence

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior exposure to compensation review processes or pay equity analysis

  • Experience in a compound startup, multi-product company, or post-acquisition environment

     

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
description:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Zero Trust | Security Engineering | Terraform | GitOps

Contexte

Pour le compte d'un grand groupe français du secteur de l'énergie, nous recherchons un Expert DevOps Cloudflare pour accompagner le déploiement et l'industrialisation d'une plateforme de sécurité Cloudflare à l'échelle de son système d'information.

L'objectif est de concevoir, configurer et automatiser les solutions Cloudflare, d'accompagner leur mise en production et d'assurer leur transfert aux équipes internes.

Principales responsabilités

  • Zero Trust & ZTNA : déploiement de Cloudflare Access et WARP, migration progressive depuis un VPN Fortinet, sécurisation des accès Citrix, des accès privilégiés et des partenaires externes.
  • Secure Web Gateway : migration depuis Zscaler vers Cloudflare Gateway, filtrage Web contextuel et protection des utilisateurs nomades.
  • Data Security & AI Governance : mise en œuvre de DLP, CASB, Browser Isolation et contrôles Shadow IT / Shadow AI.
  • Application & API Security : configuration WAF, protection anti-DDoS, sécurisation des API et mécanismes mTLS.
  • Email Security : déploiement de Cloudflare Email Security et intégration avec Google Workspace.
  • DevOps & Automation : automatisation des configurations Cloudflare via Terraform, API et GitOps, avec gestion du code sous Git/Bitbucket.
  • Observabilité & transfert : intégration des événements au SIEM, documentation technique, procédures d'exploitation et transfert de compétences aux équipes SecOps.

Requirements

Compétences indispensables

  • Expertise confirmée sur Cloudflare One : Zero Trust, Access, Gateway, WAF, Email Security, Browser Isolation et API Cloudflare.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Terraform, notamment du provider Cloudflare.
  • Expérience GitOps avec Git/Bitbucket.
  • Solides compétences cloud AWS et GCP.
  • Connaissance des protocoles d'identité SAML 2.0, OIDC et Auth0.
  • Capacité à intervenir de manière autonome sur l'architecture, l'intégration, l'automatisation et la mise en production.

Une expérience Scaleway constitue un atout.

Modalités

  • Démarrage : janvier 2027
  • Durée : 12 mois renouvelables
  • Localisation : France, télétravail autorisé
  • Présence sur site : au minimum une fois par trimestre, notamment lors des jalons clés
  • Statut : prestation freelance

Pour échanger

Merci de nous transmettre votre CV actualisé, votre TJM, votre disponibilité et quelques précisions sur vos projets Cloudflare One et Terraform les plus significatifs.
