title: Product Designer II
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Note: This is a remote role based in Pacific Time, with a preference for candidates located in San Francisco.

About The Role

Playground and Console are where developers meet Deepgram for the first time. Our redesigns are shipping into development now, and both surfaces have steady, real UI work ahead of them.

We're looking for a Product Designer to own that execution. You'll work alongside our senior designers on feature-level work, take assigned pieces end to end once the direction is set, and float to whichever surface needs design hours that week. The work is well-defined and it matters: it is the first impression of the product for most of the people who use it.

This role is deliberately flexible. You'll build fluency in our design system, our developer audience, and our product faster than you would sitting on one surface for a year, and you'll be the reason senior designers get to stay on the problems only they can solve.

You'll report directly to the Director of Product Design.

Your first chapter: feature-level UI across Playground and Console, running on Cosmos, our design system.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and refine UI across the Playground and Console experiences, working from a defined problem and a general solution direction

  • Support senior designers on feature work, taking assigned pieces end to end with minimal guidance once the approach is set

  • Pick up design work wherever capacity is needed, across product surfaces

  • Apply Cosmos consistently, and exercise judgment on the edge cases the system does not answer yet

  • Document the why alongside the what, so your decisions are legible to the team and to engineering

  • Give regular updates, present your rationale in critique, and give your peers feedback worth having

  • Use our AI and design tooling in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Take pride in execution, and care whether the spacing is right

  • Want range early, across multiple surfaces and problem types, rather than one narrow lane

  • Like designing for developers, and find technical products more interesting than intimidating

  • Want to learn from senior designers by working next to them on real work

  • Are excited to move at the pace of AI and figure out where these tools genuinely help

It’s Important To Us That You Have

We care more about expertise and leadership than years of experience.

  • Strong UI craft, with a portfolio that shows clear visual and interaction judgment

  • Experience taking feature-level work end to end, from direction through production handoff

  • Fluency working inside a design system, and the judgment to know when a pattern does not fit

  • Clear written communication, including the reasoning behind your decisions

  • Comfort with technical or abstract product surfaces

  • AI tools already in your daily practice, with a view on where they help

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience designing for developers or technical users, including APIs, SDKs, documentation, or console workflows

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS with both self-serve and enterprise motions

  • Prototyping skills beyond static screens

  • Experience contributing to a design system rather than only consuming one

  • Curiosity about voice, audio, or real-time products

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: Customer Reputation Specialist
description:
Description

TripleTenis an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps. Our mission is to help people change their lives and succeed in technology. We offer flexibility in studies, career mentoring, resume and portfolio preparation, and we guarantee employment after the course. Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics.

We are now looking for a Customer Reputation Specialist to join our LATAM team!

This role focuses on managing, de-escalating, and resolving critical and high-friction student issues across the LATAM market. You will be responsible for handling sensitive student cases, mitigating reputational and legal risks, and negotiating effective solutions while ensuring an empathetic and positive student experience.

Your main goal will be to protect the company's reputation, prevent further escalation, and reach fair and effective resolutions for students and the business.

Please submit your updated resume or CV in English.

What you will do

As a Customer Reputation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing complex student complaints and high-risk cases, communicating directly with students, and coordinating with internal teams to achieve timely and effective resolutions.

Main responsibilities will include:

  • Case Analysis: Thoroughly investigate escalated cases, understanding the context, background, and specific circumstances of each student complaint.
  • Student Communication & De-escalation: Contact students directly through calls and written channels, build rapport, actively listen to their concerns, and de-escalate high-friction situations.
  • Conflict Resolution & Negotiation: Negotiate and mediate agreements with students, aiming to reach mutually acceptable solutions and prevent further escalation, including legal claims, formal complaints, or negative social media exposure.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential reputational, legal, and business risks and take appropriate action to minimize their impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to investigate cases, align on solutions, and ensure timely resolution in accordance with company policies.
  • Documentation & Follow-up: Maintain accurate records of case progress, agreements, communications, and outcomes, ensuring proper follow-up until resolution.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, customer retention, escalations, complaints management, or high-touch customer support roles.
  • Proven experience handling difficult customers, high-conflict situations, sensitive complaints, and complex customer escalations.
  • Experience managing sensitive cases involving potential legal action, formal complaints, legal claims, or reputational risks.
  • Familiarity with handling public customer complaints, social media escalations, and situations involving threats of negative brand exposure.
  • Outstanding active listening and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and difficult conversations.
  • Exceptional empathy and emotional intelligence, combined with the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Spanish.
  • Proficiency in English for written and verbal communication.
  • Experience using Slack, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong judgment when identifying and managing high-pressure, legal, and reputational risk situations.

What we can offer you

  • 100% remote work.
  • 600 USD gross per month + monthly bonuses based on KPI results.
  • Full-time role, Monday to Friday. Schedule from 9am to 19pm Mex time UTC -6 (1 hour for lunch)
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Jira, HubSpot, Notion, etc. — to make the working together process seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team, spread out across the US, LatAm, and more!

title: Sr. Talent Partner
description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

Sr. Talent Partner (6-month contract)

FORT is entering a potential big growth year through 2027. You will be our dedicated recruiting partner for that push, owning searches end to end and working directly with hiring managers and the Director of People & Culture.

About a third of the roles are deeply technical (firmware, embedded systems, functional safety, and quality engineering). The rest span sales (including EMEA and DACH account executives), product, operations, and G&A. This is a hands-on seat: you will source, screen, coordinate, and close.

Success in your first six months looks like:

  • Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 priority roles filled on plan, with hiring managers who trust your read on candidates
  • A repeatable intake, scorecard, and debrief process every hiring team uses
  • Clean, current pipeline data in our ATS that leadership can rely on for headcount planning
  • A candidate experience that reflects FORT well, including for people we don't hire

What you'll do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for a concurrent load of roughly 12–18 open requisitions, from intake through offer acceptance
  • Lead intake meetings with hiring managers to define must-haves, interview plans, and scorecards before a role goes live
  • Source passive candidates directly through LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, technical communities, university networks, and referrals, with a focus on hard-to-find embedded and safety engineering talent
  • Screen candidates for technical fit and motivation, and give hiring managers a clear, honest recommendation
  • Coordinate interview loops, gather feedback within 24 hours, and drive debriefs to a decision
  • Partner with the Director of People & Culture on offers, using FORT's salary bands and compensation guidelines
  • Keep the ATS current and report weekly on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and risks to the hiring plan
  • Coach hiring managers on structured, consistent interviewing
  • Recruit across US and European time zones, including EMEA and DACH sales roles

What you bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including at least 2 years in-house at a startup or high-growth company
  • Proven success hiring hardware, embedded, firmware, or systems engineers; you can hold a credible conversation about the work, not just match keywords
  • Strong direct sourcing skills and a track record of filling niche technical roles without relying on agencies
  • Experience carrying a high requisition load while keeping candidates and hiring managers informed
  • Comfort pushing back on hiring managers with data when a profile, timeline, or process isn't working
  • Fluency with an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) and LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Clear, organized written communication; you keep your pipeline and notes current without being chased
  • Availability to start between November & December

Nice to have

  • Recruiting for robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, or other safety-critical hardware
  • Familiarity with functional safety roles (ISO 13849, IEC 61508, ISO 26262) and what makes a strong safety engineer
  • Experience hiring in the UK, Germany, or the broader EMEA market
  • Experience hiring enterprise or technical account executives
  • Background building a recruiting process from scratch at a company without a dedicated talent team

Engagement details

This role starts as a 6-month contract with a possibility for a full-time role in 2027.

  • Contract: hourly, through our EOR, Oyster, at a competitive market rate of $85-$95HR
  • Schedule: full-time hours, with some flexibility for early or late calls with European candidates, potentially

Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

FORT Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

FORT Robotics uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team review and organize applications. These tools do not make hiring decisions; all decisions are made by FORT employees. To request an accommodation or a review without these tools, contact .

description:
Build & own a business inside GoStudent

About GoStudent Builders

We bring the customers. You build the company.

With GoStudent Builders, we're turning validated business opportunities into independent, revenue-generating businesses. We provide the infrastructure, customer access, technology and operational support. You build and run the business.

We currently have 14 validated opportunities across several markets.

Learn more:

The opportunity

We are looking for AI-native builders who want to build and operate a business from the ground up — not simply manage an existing team or project.

You can apply as an individual or as a team of 1–3 people. You will take ownership of one specific business opportunity, validate it, launch it and grow it into a profitable company.

The business challenge for this market

1. Oposiciones prep

2. Turn marketplace demand into centre customers

3. Holiday camps at scale

4. A creator network for performance marketing
5. AI agent for lead follow-up and win-back

What you'll do

  • Take ownership of one of the identified business opportunities.

  • Build and launch a revenue-generating business from scratch.

  • Use AI tools, automation and GoStudent's infrastructure to move fast.

  • Validate customer demand, develop the offering and acquire customers.

  • Own the commercial performance, operations and growth of your business.

  • Continuously improve the business based on customer feedback and data.

What we're are looking for

  • You are an entrepreneurial builder who enjoys turning ideas into real businesses.

  • You are AI-native and use AI tools to build, automate and execute faster.

  • You are hands-on: you build, test, launch and iterate yourself.

  • You have strong ownership and are comfortable operating independently.

  • You are commercially minded and focused on generating revenue.

  • You are fluent in English; some opportunities may require the local language.

  • Previous experience in education is not required.

What GoStudents provides

  • Access to more than 200,000 customers and an established network of 850+ locations.

  • Existing infrastructure, licenses, sales capabilities and operational support.

  • Access to BrutalOS, GoStudent's AI agent platform.

  • The opportunity to build on an established platform rather than starting entirely from zero.

The business model

This is an entrepreneurial ownership opportunity, not a traditional salaried position.

  • You own 75% of the business; GoStudent owns 25%.

  • There is no fixed salary. Your income comes from the earnings and profits of the business.

  • GoStudent charges a fee on revenue routed through its channels.

  • From year three, GoStudent may acquire a majority stake at a pre-agreed fixed EBITDA multiple, paid in GoStudent shares.

Location and setup

  • Location: Spain, remote

  • Working model: Remote

  • Team size: Individual applicants or teams of 1–3

  • Working language: English, with local language requirements depending on the business opportunity

  • Start date: January 2027

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
